prediction_fields.name: monthly_cost_sharing_cap
prediction_fields.description: Maximum enrollee cost sharing for a one-month supply of a covered insulin product, effective January 1, 2023.

prediction_fields.name: reimbursement_deadline_days
prediction_fields.description: Number of calendar days within which Part D sponsors must reimburse enrollees for any cost-sharing amount charged above $35 during the transition period.

discussion_points: How does the documented input 'monthly_cost_sharing_cap' condition downstream implementation activities? Sets the primary cost-sharing limit that sponsors must implement at the point of sale, directly determining enrollee out-of-pocket costs and the basis for the retrospective subsidy.

How does the documented input 'reimbursement_deadline_days' condition downstream implementation activities? Establishes the compliance burden for sponsors during the transition period, affecting their administrative processes and potential penalties for non-compliance.
